# Baseline on the Hinglish / prompt-talk evaluation sets (generated by ml/hinglish_baseline_eval.py)

Served thresholds (block = max, warn = min of the model's val tuning). Rates k/n with Wilson 95% intervals. Human Hinglish = Hinglish-TOP (Apache-2.0), human-written; the two AI-drafted sets are Gemini-generated.
